summary: Regression testing of round-2 code-review fixes: additional array-key changes in FreeAuditOffer.jsx (6 fixes), ServiceAreaPage.jsx (3 more), IndustryPage.jsx (4), BusinessReality.jsx (1), and backend send_lead_notification refactor into 3 helper functions (_resolve_lead_source, _build_lead_text_body, _build_lead_html_body). General smoke check: scrolled full homepage top-to-bottom (0-20000px in 1000px increments) plus industry and city pages - zero console errors, zero React 'duplicate key' / 'same key' warnings detected in devtools console across all tested pages
action_items: None required - no regressions found in any of the round-2 array-key changes or the backend send_lead_notification refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: FreeAuditOffer.jsx: gap.id/opp.id/cat.id keys all derive from the same allCategories array with 6 hardcoded unique ids (manual, automation, ai, access, continuity, human) - confirmed unique, safe for React keys.

ServiceAreaPage.jsx anchor key: btaAnchors uses anchorFor(city.slug, 0/1/2) which are 3 consecutive modulo offsets into a 12-item array - guaranteed distinct per city, so anchor text is a safe React key.

IndustryPage.jsx and cityData.js: manually verified all challenges/compliance/software arrays and testimonialIndices arrays across sampled industries/cities contain no duplicate values within a single array, confirming the string/id-based keys are safe.

backend/server.py: _resolve_lead_source, _build_lead_text_body, _build_lead_html_body are pure extractions with identical logic to the original inline code - verified via live curl test and backend log inspection showing correct email subject/body construction and successful send.
No file size, DRY, or async/await issues observed in the reviewed files this round.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed leads were created in the leads collection during this round's regression testing (audit offer, city form). Expected test data, not production data.
